description: Use to monitor or research public Telegram channels (crypto, news, project announcements, signals): pass a channel username (e.g. durov, telegram, or a t.me link) and get up to 20 recent posts with text, ISO date, view count, outbound links, forwarded-from, photo/video flags and t.me post URLs, plus the channel title, bio and subscriber count. Add q= to search posts within that channel, before= to page back. Only public channels with the web preview enabled; no login, no private chats or groups. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.002 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.

before.description: Return posts older than this post id (pagination).

channel.description: Public channel username or t.me link.

q.description: Optional keyword search within the channel.
